description.message: Send the sound of one tab to the speaker or headphones you choose. Works with the Lark app for Mac.

allowDevices.message: Allow access to the device list…

popupHint.message: Other tabs and apps are not affected. Choose “Same as everything” to return.

noDevices.message: Chrome shows device names only after you allow it once.

setupTitle.message: Allow Lark for Chrome to see your speakers

setupText.message: Chrome lists speakers and headphones only to extensions that have microphone permission. Lark does not record anything: right after the list appears, the microphone is released.

setupDone.message: Done. You can close this tab: right-click any page → Lark.

setupFailed.message: Chrome did not allow it. Click the lock icon in the address bar and allow the microphone, then try again.

cantCapture.message: This page’s sound can’t be redirected (Chrome doesn’t allow it on its own pages).
